hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); echo "$INPUT" | jq -r "{source: \"project_settings\", file_path: (.tool_input.file_path // empty)}" | bash code/part2-hooks/lifecycle/audit-config.sh'

"C:\Program Files\Git\usr\bin\bash.exe" -l -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE_PATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [ -z "$FILE_PATH" ] && exit 0; EXT="${FILE_PATH##*.}"; case "$EXT" in js|jsx|ts|tsx|css|json) npx prettier --write "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null ;; go) gofmt -w "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null ;; py) black "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null ;; md) npx markdownlint-cli2 --fix "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null ;; esac'

hooks.prompt:
Review the result of the file edit:
$ARGUMENTS

Only if tool_input.file_path is a .ts or .js file, check for obvious security issues (SQL injection, XSS, hardcoded credentials).
If issues are found, return ok: false with a specific reason. If no issues or the file type is not applicable, return ok: true.
{"ok": true/false, "reason": "reason"}
